title: You Turned Her Against Me
_howto: This mirrors The Choicer Voicer's Star Wars dub pack (~17 lines, ~85s, 2 characters).
1. Get your own clip of the scene as an mp4/mkv on disk.
2. Copy this file, drop the .example from the name, fill in the real line text
and start/end timings in ms (scrub the clip in QuickTime/VLC to read them off).
3. Use trim.startMs/endMs if your file has extra footage around the scene.
5. Refresh the app — the scene shows up in the picker. Media stays out of git.
